property: The model has one assertion, checked in every cycle: !rst -> (!(pop && (!ALLOW_BYPASS || fifo_size > 0)) || (data_out == ref_fifo[ref_fifo_head])). I.e. the FIFO output equals the reference FIFO entry at the head pointer.
mem_havoc: The ref_fifo array is flattened into registers; abstract_state on one is a reference-memory havoc.
